newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Two S.Korean firms buy 23,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Two S.Korean firms buy 23,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat.

text.p: South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd jointly bought 23,000 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat from Japanese trading house Marubeni Corp, company officials said on Friday.
Of the total, Cheiljedang bought 9,500 tonnes at basis prices over July futures on the U.S grain futures exchanges including the Chicago Board of Trade, they said.
Dongah Flour purchased the remaining 13,500 tonnes at fixed prices.
Shipment was set for May 5-June 5 to the southeastern port of Pusan.
